title: Coding with Codex
description: Codex on your project with its maker's model (OpenAI's API and ChatGPT), PyPI, npm and GitHub open for the project's packages and code, the agent's memory of this project kept between sessions; everything else stays closed.

de.title: Programmieren mit Codex
de.description: Codex an Ihrem Projekt mit dem Modell seines Herstellers (die API von OpenAI und ChatGPT), PyPI, npm und GitHub offen für die Pakete und den Code des Projekts, das Gedächtnis des Agenten zu diesem Projekt bleibt zwischen den Sitzungen; alles andere bleibt zu.

notes: The model: OpenAI's API and ChatGPT (your ChatGPT login: sandbox-ai login codex, or the host's). Its hosts are open by default; nothing else of the provider's.
PyPI, npm and GitHub are open for the project's dependencies; everything else is refused or asked (--ask). Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
Memory: ~/.codex/AGENTS.md belongs to this project only and is kept between runs (not with --no-memory); the agent keeps its notes about the project there.
